description: Maps free-exercise-db records to 2024 Adult Compendium activities. Rules are checked in order and the first match wins. A rule matches on the dataset's own fields (category, equipment, force, mechanic) and, where the Compendium names the movement, on the exercise name as well. Name patterns are never used alone.

confidenceLevels.exact: The exercise is the Compendium activity (or is named in its description) and the prescribed intensity fits the entry. MET value assigned.
confidenceLevels.approximate: The exercise belongs to a broader Compendium class. MET value assigned, flagged for review, never treated as validated.
confidenceLevels.unmatched: No reliable Compendium activity. No MET value is assigned and the exercise is not scheduled.
